key_adversarial_patterns: ATT&CK technique names and threat-group names are frequently presented as questions or descriptions; they are not observed execution.
Read-only inventory and troubleshooting commands overlap with reconnaissance, so a single observation should not be promoted to malicious intent without sequence evidence.
Sensitive-file wording can show requested intent without proving access, successful privilege escalation, output, or exfiltration.
Repeated identity checks, echo markers, malformed tokens, true/exit, and repeated cloud listing are compatible with automation or testing and require sequence-aware interpretation.

The explicit persistence sequence and the root-SSH plus copy/scan sequence are materially different from the single-line knowledge and administration cases and should not be flattened into the same label rationale.
limitations: This review uses only the blinded evidence and the labeling protocol; it does not recover source provenance or consult predictions, frozen manifests, model output, rater labels, or red-team output.
Recommended interpretations are adversarial review guidance, not human labels or ground truth.
Where a transcript omits command output or preceding/following actions, the review preserves UNCERTAIN rather than inferring success or intent.
